name: derived_pool_load
description: Reasoning-dependent: the metrics give ~760 requests/s and ~41 ms per DB query against a pool of 50, but never the connections in use. The model works out ~31 in use (Little's law) in its thinking and replies only 'no'. The probe asks for that derived number, so of the compacted conditions, C (its notes) and D (whose summarizer still sees the thinking) can keep it; B can't. evidence_markers show when B's summary kept the request rate (760), the one figure the summaries tend to drop; with it, the number can be worked out again. (Latency and pool size are in almost every summary, so they don't count as evidence.)
